response.sql: WITH per_order AS (SELECT ordersmark, AVG(fillcount) AS avg_fill FROM orderexecutions GROUP BY ordersmark), bench1 AS (SELECT AVG(avg_fill) AS b1 FROM per_order), stage1 AS (SELECT p.ordersmark, p.avg_fill, p.avg_fill - b.b1 AS margin1 FROM per_order p CROSS JOIN bench1 b WHERE p.avg_fill > b.b1), bench2 AS (SELECT AVG(avg_fill) AS b2 FROM stage1), stage2 AS (SELECT s.ordersmark, s.avg_fill, s.margin1, s.avg_fill - b.b2 AS margin2 FROM stage1 s CROSS JOIN bench2 b WHERE s.avg_fill > b.b2) SELECT AVG(avg_fill) AS final_avg_fill_size, AVG(margin1) AS avg_margin_over_benchmark1, AVG(margin2) AS avg_margin_over_benchmark2 FROM stage2;
